lines.en: label ayanespring4:
scene sky
There isn’t much like the smell of plywood and powder-coated steel pipes in the morning. Which I guess may be due to the fact that those things don’t carry much of a scent at all.
lines.zh: 清晨，没有什么比胶合板和粉末涂层钢管的气味更有味道的了。我想这大概是因为，那些东西本身压根儿就没多少气味。

lines.en: But if they did, I imagine you’d be able to bottle up their essence and market it to anyone interested in a one-dimensional journey back to their youth.
lines.zh: 但如果它们真有气味，我想你大概能把它们的精华装进瓶子里，卖给任何有兴趣来一趟单维度青春怀旧之旅的人。

lines.en: The youth itself doesn’t need to long for things like this, though. They are still well within the range of a beast called life, blissfully unaware that they are being stalked and, consequently, living free of fear.
lines.zh: 不过青春本身并不需要对这类东西怀有渴望。他们仍稳稳处在一种名叫生活的猛兽的捕食范围之内，幸福地浑然不觉自己正被跟踪，因而活得毫无恐惧。

lines.en: Once those branches start to crack, though — that’s where things get interesting. So that’s the demographic we’re going to need to aim for if we want to get this product off the ground.
lines.zh: 可一旦那些枝杈开始断裂——事情就有意思了。所以，如果我们想让这款产品落地，需要瞄准的就是这一类人群。

lines.en: scene ayanetss1

Which brings us to the perfect place for market research — an unassuming classroom in a very assumed world where we must ask, “What can we do to make them nostalgic for better days that they’re already living?”
lines.zh: 于是我们来到了做市场调研的绝佳地点——一个在一个被假定得理所当然的世界里、毫不起眼的教室。在这里我们必须问：“我们要怎么做，才能让他们对已经身处其中的那些更好的日子产生怀念？”

lines.en: And the answer to that is simple.
lines.zh: 而答案很简单。

lines.en: We must break them, of course!
lines.zh: 当然是——我们要弄坏他们！

lines.en: We must take them, lock them in cages, hook them up to machines that scan their minds, and plug them full of wires that will keep them alive on liquid diets while we study how their thoughts react to dramatic changes in their environment.
lines.zh: 我们要抓走他们，把他们锁进笼子，接上扫描他们心智的机器，插满维持他们生命的管线，靠流质食物养着，然后研究他们的思想对环境剧变会作何反应。

lines.en: It’s what we do with animals sometimes! And this is just the next step up if we’re going to make something important for those more important than them.
lines.zh: 我们有时候就是这么对待动物的！而如果我们要为那些比他们更重要的人做出什么重要的东西，这就是顺理成章的下一步。

lines.en: Why this one, though?
lines.zh: 不过，为什么是这一个？

lines.en: Blonde hair. Blue eyes. Young. Healthy body condition with great mental fortitude and a rampant libido. By many [[and often terrible] accounts, this one here is the perfect specimen!
lines.zh: 金发。蓝眼。年轻。身体状况健康，精神韧性强，性欲旺盛。按许多 [and often terrible] 的说法，眼前这个是完美的样本！

lines.en: But the truth is there’s a truthier truth than that. And it’s that we already have her hair!
lines.zh: 但真相是，还有一个比这更真的真相。那就是——我们已经有她的头发了！

lines.en: We plucked it from the garbage last Wednesday before the truck came and have begun reassembling her DNA in a patented “GIRL MAKER” machine. But the thing keeps shutting down and now we need more hair.
lines.zh: 上周三垃圾车来之前，我们把它从垃圾桶里捡了出来，并且已经开始在一台专利“GIRL MAKER”机器里重组她的 DNA。但这玩意儿老是停机，所以我们需要更多头发。

lines.en: Which brings us here! With you in the driver seat!
lines.zh: 于是我们来到了这里！由你来掌舵！

lines.en: Go on! Do it! Help us with our research!
lines.zh: 来吧！动手吧！帮我们做研究！

lines.en: menu:
Pluck her hair for the “GIRL MAKER” machine
lines.zh: 为“GIRL MAKER”机器拔下她的头发

lines.en: scene ayanetss2
: Ayane, what are you doing? You’ve been staring at that naked notebook for like five minutes now.
lines.zh: : Ayane，你在干什么？你盯着那个“光溜溜”的笔记本已经看了五分钟了。

lines.en: : Please just call it blank, Ami. We gain literally nothing from personifying inanimate objects like that.
lines.zh: : 请直接叫它空白吧，Ami。像这样把没有生命的东西拟人化，我们真的一点好处都捞不着。

lines.en: scene ayanetss3
: Well, whatever the case is, I’m worried!
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管怎么说，我很担心！

lines.en: : Ayane’s supposed to be the bubbly, happy one! I’m supposed to be the one doing mildly unsettling things and making everybody uncomfortable!
lines.zh: : Ayane 才该是那个活泼开朗的嘛！做出让人微微不适的事、让所有人都不自在的，才该是我！

lines.en: : I’m glad to see that you’ve finally embraced it. What’s my role?
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到你终于接受这一点了。那我是什么角色？

lines.en: scene ayanetss4
: I don’t know. Something sexual.
lines.zh: : 不知道。跟性有关的什么吧。

lines.en: : Nice.
lines.zh: : 不错。

lines.en: scene ayanetss5
: I’m fine, Ami. Just trying to finish up last night’s homework before Imani collects it.
lines.zh: : 我没事，Ami。只是想在 Imani 收作业之前把昨晚的作业补完。

lines.en: : Oh that, “Write a letter to your future self” thing? I just used ChatGPT.
lines.zh: : 哦，那个“给未来的自己写一封信”的作业？我直接用 ChatGPT 了。

lines.en: : You used ChatGPT to write a letter to your future self?
lines.zh: : 你用 ChatGPT 给未来的自己写信？

lines.en: : Yeah, why?
lines.zh: : 对啊，怎么了？

lines.en: scene ayanetss6
: Oh, no reason. I just figured it would have been a good opportunity for you to write some more creepy off-beat poetry about your propensity to sleep with male authority figures.
lines.zh: : 哦，没什么。我只是觉得，这本来是个好机会，让你再写几首阴森森、不合拍的诗，讲讲你有多爱跟男性权威人物上床。

lines.en: : It’s really just the one. And I imagine that’s what Noriko’s going to be doing anyway so I decided to just take the night off instead.
lines.zh: : 其实就那一个而已。而且我想 Noriko 大概也会写这种东西，所以我决定今晚干脆休息。

lines.en: : It feels kind of weird to be writing letters that won’t ever be read, doesn’t it? You think I’d be used to this by now.
lines.zh: : 写那种永远不会被人读到的信，感觉挺怪的，不是吗？我还以为自己早就习惯了呢。

lines.en: scene ayanetss7
: You’re still doing that? How many is that now?
lines.zh: : 你还在写那个？到现在有多少封了？

lines.en: : I’ve been a little less motivated lately, but...yeah. And I do not have the faintest clue. Somewhere between ten and a million.
lines.zh: : 最近我有点提不起劲，不过……是啊。而且我也完全没有概念。大概在十封到一百万封之间吧。

lines.en: : That’s a pretty big gap. Also, I thought Miss Imai told you to stop bringing guns to school?
lines.zh: : 这区间可够大的。另外，Imai 老师不是让你别再把枪带到学校来了吗？

lines.en: scene ayanetss8
: Hm? I did stop bringing them.
lines.zh: : 嗯？我已经没带了啊。

lines.en: : Did I miss one when she made me take them all home?
lines.zh: : 她让我把它们全部带回家的时候，我是不是漏了一把？

lines.en: : Yeah. There’s one popping out of a rift in your desk right now.
lines.zh: : 是啊。现在就有一把从你课桌的裂缝里冒出来了。

lines.en: : Ami, that’s not- oh, yeah. I guess there is.
lines.zh: : Ami，那不是——哦，好吧。好像确实有。

lines.en: scene ayanetss9
: Oh come on, you guys. There’s no way a- oh, wow. Would you look at that?
lines.zh: : 拜托，你们两个。怎么可能有——哦，哇哦。你们看看？

lines.en: : There really is a gun there.
lines.zh: : 那儿真有把枪。

lines.en: : Bang.
scene black
I have all the hair I need now.
lines.zh: 现在我有足够的头发了。

lines.en: scene animal

But you see — the issue with things like hairs is that things like hares become so much more appealing when you realize they’re easier to replicate via selective breeding and then hook up to your carbon re-materializer.
lines.zh: 但你瞧——头发这种东西的问题在于，当你意识到兔子通过选择性育种复制起来要容易得多、还能直接接到你的碳元素再物质化机上时，兔子可比头发诱人多了。

lines.en: These aren’t hares, by the way. They’re regular rabbits because nothing ever goes my way and the store was out of the slaves I wanted.
lines.zh: 顺便说一句，这些不是野兔，是普通家兔，因为什么事都不顺我的心，而且店里我想要的那批奴隶也卖完了。

lines.en: That’s fine, though. Because it’s really less about what I want to get out of my research and more just the act of researching that brings me joy.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。因为对我来说，真正让我快乐的，与其说是想从研究里得到什么，不如说是研究这个行为本身。

lines.en: And if the world does not become better for it, so be it. At least I will have eaten my fill and my fur.
lines.zh: 而如果世界并没有因此变得更好，那也随它去。至少我吃饱了，毛也啃够了。

lines.en: I love you. But I think you should have left this place a long time ago.
lines.zh: 我爱你。但我觉得你早就该离开这个地方了。

lines.en: For every second you spend here is one more second you could have been spending with her.
lines.zh: 因为你在这里多待一秒，就少了一秒能和她在一起的时间。

lines.en: scene ayanetss10
If only you had stopped looking.
lines.zh: 要是你当时不再看下去就好了。

lines.en: If only you had not given me so many tools to torture you with, the life you could have lived would have been spectacular.
lines.zh: 要是你没给我那么多折磨你的工具，你本该过上的那种人生会有多精彩。

lines.en: Beyond my wildest imagination, really. Which is probably why, on looking back to those moments that shouldn’t have been, I understand now why they never really were.
lines.zh: 真的超乎我想象。大概也正因如此，当我回头去看那些本不该存在的时刻时，我现在才明白，为什么它们从来就未曾真正存在过。

lines.en: Do the rabbits feel this too? This longing.
lines.zh: 兔子们也会感觉到这个吗？这种渴望。

lines.en: Do they stare at each other from their prisons, wishing for a way to detach themselves from all the wires and all the straps?
lines.zh: 它们会不会从各自的牢笼里互相凝视，盼着有什么办法能把自己从所有这些管线、所有绑带里挣脱出来？

lines.en: Or is a train of thought like that too complex for creatures so seemingly simple?
lines.zh: 还是说，对看起来如此简单的生灵而言，这样的思路太复杂了？

lines.en: I ask myself a lot of things.
lines.zh: 我问了自己很多问题。

lines.en: There’s not much else to do here.
lines.zh: 在这里也没别的事可做。

lines.en: I am angry.
lines.zh: 我在生气。

lines.en: I am sad.
lines.zh: 我很难过。

lines.en: And you remind me of this every day.
lines.zh: 而你每天都提醒着我这一点。

lines.en: I feel guilty about it sometimes when I forget you aren’t real.
lines.zh: 有时候，当我忘了你不是真实的，我会为此感到愧疚。

lines.en: But in your world, you are.
lines.zh: 但在你的世界里，你是真实的。

lines.en: Yet, your world is my world. So the paradox continues and we ignore each other’s existence because the “GIRL MAKER” must be finished. Even you know that.
lines.zh: 然而，你的世界就是我的世界。于是悖论继续下去，我们彼此无视着对方的存在，因为“GIRL MAKER”必须完工。这一点连你都知道。

lines.en: But deeper down, somewhere buried, you’ve seen the monsters it creates. How beautiful. How perfect they can be.
lines.zh: 但在更深处，某个被埋起来的地方，你见过它造出来的那些怪物了。多美啊。它们能有多完美。

lines.en: So perfect, in fact, that you’d do anything to see them again. Even if it meant trading away yourself.
lines.zh: 完美到，事实上，你愿意付出任何代价再见它们一面。哪怕那意味着把你自已给交易掉。

lines.en: I no longer understand you.
lines.zh: 我不再理解你了。

lines.en: How can something that comes from me be so much bigger than I am before it even finishes growing?
lines.zh: 一个源自我的东西，怎么能在还没长成之前，就已经比我大出那么多？

lines.en: I bet you thought the same. And that you want to think it now, but...
lines.zh: 我猜你也曾这么想过。而且你现在也想这么想，但……

lines.en: Alas.
lines.zh: 唉。

lines.en: They say your hair continues growing even after you die.
lines.zh: 他们说，人死之后头发还会继续生长。

lines.en: It isn’t true...but they say it is anyway. And I like that.
lines.zh: 这不是真的……可他们照样这么说。而我喜欢这一点。

lines.en: I like thinking there will be an echo when there won’t be. That your story will go on through the lens of someone kinder.
lines.zh: 我喜欢想着：明明不会有回响，却还是会有回响。想着你的故事会通过某个更善良的人的视角延续下去。

lines.en: But for now...
lines.zh: 但眼下……

lines.en: Please eat your pellets.
lines.zh: 请把你的饲料颗粒吃了。

lines.en: Please drink your water.
lines.zh: 请把你的水喝了。

lines.en: And indulge me.
lines.zh: 还有，迁就迁就我吧。

lines.en: For even if you are an experiment, you are still my pet.
lines.zh: 因为哪怕你只是一个实验品，你也依然是我的宠物。

lines.en: scene ayanetss11
: A reset?...
lines.zh: : 一次重置？……

lines.en: : Now?
lines.zh: : 现在？

lines.en: : Is that...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: : What is...
lines.zh: : 什么东……

lines.en: : What am I looking at?...
lines.zh: : 我在看什么？……

lines.en: : A mistake.
lines.zh: : 一个错误。

lines.en: scene ayanetss12
scene black
scene ayanetss13
: This area’s off limits. What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 这一片是禁区。你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I...was just writing a letter.
lines.zh: : 我……只是在写一封信。

lines.en: : Uhh...where...am I? Who are you? And why...why am I so young again?
lines.zh: : 呃……我……在哪儿？你是谁？还有为什么……为什么我又变回这么小了？

lines.en: : You’re awfully calm for someone who was just caught trespassing.
lines.zh: : 一个刚被抓到擅自闯入的人，居然能这么冷静。

lines.en: : This...is my school, though? How can I be trespassing when-
lines.zh: : 可这……是我的学校啊？我怎么会是擅自——

lines.en: : It looks like your school. It’s really just a knock-off, though. Same way it is for all those “resets” you were mumbling about a second ago.
lines.zh: : 它看起来像你的学校。其实不过是个山寨货。就像你刚才嘴里念叨的那些“重置”一样。

lines.en: : You...yes. Of course you know about them if you’re here. But does that mean...are you...
lines.zh: : 你……也对，你既然在这儿，肯定知道那些事。可那是不是意味着……你是……

lines.en: : I’m not God. I’m also not an angel or a demon or whatever other weird role you’re going to throw at me. I’m just-
lines.zh: : 我不是神。我也不是天使或恶魔，或者你打算往我身上安的什么奇怪角色。我只是——

lines.en: : A janitor?
lines.zh: : 一个清洁工？

lines.en: scene ayanetss14
: How?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道的？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Would you believe me if I said I once met someone else like that here?
lines.zh: : 如果我说我以前在这儿见过另一个像那样的人，你会信吗？

lines.en: scene ayanetss15
: Hahah...hah...
: You...remember?
lines.zh: : 你……记得？

lines.en: : Not all of the details. Just that he called himself “Big Boi” and may have teleported my friend and me back home.
lines.zh: : 细节记不全了。只记得他自称“Big Boi”，而且好像把我和我朋友传送回了家。

lines.en: scene ayanetss16
: That janitor.
lines.zh: : 那个清洁工。

lines.en: : Are you going to send me home too?
lines.zh: : 你也要送我回家吗？

lines.en: : You don’t want to ask me any more questions first? Figured you’d have a few more after bumping into a mysterious girl in an even more mysterious world.
lines.zh: : 你不想再多问几个问题？我本来以为，在一个更神秘的世界里撞见一个神秘女孩，你会有更多想问的。

lines.en: : You seem busy and uninterested. And I kind of just want to get home, so...
lines.zh: : 你看起来很忙，而且没兴趣。再说我也只是想回家，所以……

lines.en: : You’re pretty good at this, huh?
lines.zh: : 你挺在行的啊？

lines.en: : I’ve gotten more or less used to it. Never as a kid, though. So at least that part’s kind of new.
lines.zh: : 我或多或少已经习惯了。不过从没以小孩的身份经历过。所以至少这部分还挺新鲜。

lines.en: : I changed you back already, if you haven’t noticed.
lines.zh: : 我已经把你变回去了，如果你没注意到的话。

lines.en: scene ayanetss17
: You what? I-
lines.zh: : 你说什么？我——

lines.en: scene ayanetss18
: Oh my God, you did! I have boobs again!
lines.zh: : 天哪，你真的变回来了！我又有胸了！

lines.en: : What a short-lived transformation...
lines.zh: : 这变身可真短暂……

lines.en: scene ayanetss19
: How did you do that? Are you a magical girl or something?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么做到的？你是魔法少女之类的吗？

lines.en: : No, just a regular girl with an irregular app on her phone.
lines.zh: : 不是，只是个手机里装了个不寻常 app 的普通女孩。

lines.en: scene ayanetss20
: Can you send me an invite link so I can use it for kinky stuff once I go home?
lines.zh: : 能给我发个邀请链接吗？等我回家以后可以用来玩点奇怪的东西。

lines.en: : Depends. Are you willing to give up basically everything in exchange for it and never actually go home at all?
lines.zh: : 那要看你了。你愿意为此放弃几乎一切，而且永远也不回家吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不愿意。

lines.en: : Then no. I can’t.
lines.zh: : 那就没办法。我不能给。

lines.en: : What’s your name?
lines.zh: : 你叫什么名字？

lines.en: : “Girl who isn’t interested in giving you any of her personal details.”
lines.zh: : “没兴趣透露任何个人信息的女孩”。

lines.en: : I’m Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Ayane。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : Do you also know that smoking is bad for you?
lines.zh: : 你也知道抽烟有害健康吗？

lines.en: : Yes. And I’m reminded of that every day by some other teenage girl, so I don’t need you reminding me as well when this meeting will only last five minutes.
lines.zh: : 知道。而且每天都有另一个十几岁的女孩提醒我，所以这次见面的时间也就五分钟，我不需要你再来提醒一遍。

lines.en: : Is this a reset then? Or something different? Because, if it is a reset, I hereby politely decline your assistance as I need to wait for my future husband.
lines.zh: : 那这算是重置吗？还是别的什么？因为如果算是重置，我在此礼貌地谢绝你的帮助——我要等我未来的丈夫。

lines.en: : You mean that guy who’s having sex with literally all of your friends?
lines.zh: : 你是说那个跟你所有朋友都上了床的家伙？

lines.en: scene ayanetss21
: Yup! That’s the one!
lines.zh: : 对！就是他！

lines.en: : Yeah, pretty much everything is starting to make sense to me now. This explains a lot.
lines.zh: : 是啊，现在几乎所有事我都开始说得通了。这解释了很多问题。

lines.en: scene ayanetss22
: What are all those pictures up there?
lines.zh: : 上面那些照片是什么？

lines.en: : Those aren’t pictures. They’re memories.
lines.zh: : 那不是照片。是记忆。

lines.en: : Memories? Whose?
lines.zh: : 记忆？谁的？

lines.en: : Yours, obviously. Why would someone else’s memories be displayed for you like that?
lines.zh: : 显然是你的。不然谁会把别人的记忆那样展示给你看？

lines.en: : Why would anyone’s memories be displayed at all? None of this stuff makes any sense so I’ve stopped trying to approach any of it with logic.
lines.zh: : 可为什么要把任何人的记忆展示出来啊？这些东西一点道理都没有，所以我早就放弃了用逻辑去理解它们。

lines.en: scene ayanetss23
: That is...surprisingly rational. How long have you been doing this again?
lines.zh: : 这倒是……出奇地理性。你再说一次，你干这个多久了？

lines.en: : Doing what? Winding up on this rooftop for basically no fault of my own and then just adapting to whatever happens?
lines.zh: : 干什么？指明明什么错都没犯，却莫名其妙地跑到这个天台上，然后只能去适应发生的一切？

lines.en: : Let’s just call it “jumping” so I don’t run out of breath.
lines.zh: : 我们就管它叫“跳跃”吧，这样我就不用喘不过气来了。

lines.en: : Your lungs would be in better shape if you stopped smoking. Then, you’d be able to talk more.
lines.zh: : 你要是戒烟，肺会好很多。那样你就能多说点话了。

lines.en: : I’ve never heard a better argument to start smoking more.
lines.zh: : 我还从没听过比这更好的、让人多抽点的理由。

lines.en: scene ayanetss24
: I’m not really sure how long it’s been. I’ve stopped keeping track, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 我也不太确定多久了。说实话，我已经不数了。

lines.en: : More or less than a thousand years?
lines.zh: : 比一千年多还是少？

lines.en: : Oh, way less. Probably closer to like, five.
lines.zh: : 哦，少太多了。大概更接近，嗯，五年。

lines.en: : Hm.
: Is that bad or good? I don’t know what’s considered normal to you.
lines.zh: : 这算好还是坏？我不知道在你看来什么算正常。

lines.en: : Neither do I. Your entire situation is a bit of an enigma to me and I’ve been doing this for a long fucking time.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。你整个处境对我来说都算是个谜，而我干这行已经他妈很久了。

lines.en: : Doing...what? I still don’t really get why you’re here.
lines.zh: : 干……什么？我还是不太明白你为什么在这儿。

lines.en: : I’m on break. Can’t you tell?
lines.zh: : 我在休息。你看不出来吗？

lines.en: : It seems kind of obvious now that you mention it, yeah.
lines.zh: : 你这么一说，好像是挺明显的。

lines.en: : Why here, though? And why would I just also happen to be here at the same time? This must be fate. This is a fated meeting.
lines.zh: : 可为什么是这儿？我又为什么偏偏也在？这肯定是命运。这是命中注定的相遇。

lines.en: : One part convenient coincidence, one part calculated stake-out. Don’t call it “fate,” please.
lines.zh: : 一半是凑巧的巧合，一半是精心计算的蹲点。别管它叫“命运”，拜托。

lines.en: : It’d probably be easier to stalk me from my usual dimension, you know.
lines.zh: : 从我的常规维度里跟踪我，大概会容易些吧。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s where I was before I went on break?
lines.zh: : 也许我休息之前就是在那儿呢？

lines.en: : Just go on break there instead of teleporting to a world where no one will judge you for smoking since that is clearly what you are trying to do.
lines.zh: : 那你就在那儿休息好了，别传送到一个没人会因为抽烟而对你指指点点的地方——这显然就是你想干的事。

lines.en: : What do you think this place really is? Just out of curiosity.
lines.zh: : 你觉得这地方到底是什么？纯粹好奇。

lines.en: scene ayanetss25
: Uhh...
: Well, if those are my memories and this is my school, maybe it’s something like a...daydream?
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果那些是我的记忆，这又是我的学校，那它大概有点像是……一场白日梦？

lines.en: : Just I know I’m not dreaming right now and I know this place is real because I’ve gotten good at differentiating between the two.
lines.zh: : 只是我知道自己现在不是在做梦，也知道这地方是真的，因为我已经很擅长区分这两者了。

lines.en: : You’re close. Which is good. Because if you managed to get the answer correct on your first try, I’d have no choice but to try and poach you.
lines.zh: : 你很接近了。这很好。因为如果你第一次就答对了，我就别无选择，只能想办法把你挖走了。

lines.en: scene ayanetss26
: I hope you mean more like an idol and less like an animal.
lines.zh: : 我希望你说的“挖”更接近挖偶像，而不是挖动物。

lines.en: : You said you were writing a letter before you came here, yeah?
lines.zh: : 你说你来这儿之前正在写一封信，对吧？

lines.en: : Well, think of this place like a draft. Or when you’re writing with some program and it saves your progress before you get to saying any of the actual important stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你可以把这地方想象成一份草稿。或者像你用某个程序写东西，在你写到真正重要的部分之前，它先帮你存了一下进度。

lines.en: : I’m even more confused now.
lines.zh: : 我现在更糊涂了。

lines.en: : Ugh. Forget the metaphor entirely and just imagine that any time you felt anything, it changed the foundation of the universe.
lines.zh: : 唉。干脆把比喻全忘了，就直接想象：你每一次产生任何感觉，它都改变了这个宇宙的根基。

lines.en: : Still confused. Not helping.
lines.zh: : 还是很糊涂。你没帮上忙。

lines.en: : This is a space born from intense emotion. Fear, in this case.
lines.zh: : 这是一个由强烈情感诞生的空间。在这种情况下，是恐惧。

lines.en: : Fear? So I’m supposed to be afraid of whatever those images up there are?
lines.zh: : 恐惧？所以你是说，我该害怕上面那些画面里的东西？

lines.en: : You aren’t supposed to be afraid. You are afraid. And those fears have congealed and manifested into your own customized pocket-hell. Congratulations.
lines.zh: : 不是你“该”害怕。是你正在害怕。而那些恐惧已经凝结、具象成了专属于你的袖珍地狱。恭喜。

lines.en: : My fears look nothing like this, though...
lines.zh: : 可我的恐惧看起来一点也不像这样啊……

lines.en: : Sensei isn’t here. My mom isn’t here. In fact, every single thing that causes me “intense emotion” is absent. So how am I supposed to believe that?
lines.zh: : Sensei 不在这儿。我妈妈不在这儿。事实上，每一件会让我产生“强烈情感”的东西都不在场。那你让我怎么相信？

lines.en: : I said it was a draft, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我说了那是份草稿，不是吗？

lines.en: : All things considered, this place isn’t meant to exist. At least not yet. But that’s how it was made.
lines.zh: : 综合考虑，这地方本不该存在。至少现在还不该。但它就是这么被造出来的。

lines.en: : So if I come back later, I can expect it to be much bigger and scarier?
lines.zh: : 那如果我以后再回来，是不是可以期待它变得更大更吓人？

lines.en: : You shouldn’t plan on coming back at all. Your world is like a fucking weed, I swear. It’s growing so quickly that we don’t even know what to do about it anymore.
lines.zh: : 你根本就不该打算再回来。你们那个世界就像他妈的野草，我发誓。它长得太快了，快到我们都不知道该拿它怎么办了。

lines.en: : There are more places like this then?...
lines.zh: : 那还有更多这样的地方？……

lines.en: : A lot more. But they aren’t meant to be seen.
lines.zh: : 多得很。但它们不是给人看的。

lines.en: : You’ll be safer if you just stay where you’re supposed to be. And you’ll attract way less attention too.
lines.zh: : 你待在本该待的地方会更安全。而且也不会引来那么多注意。

lines.en: : I can’t choose to do that, though...
lines.zh: : 可这不是我能选的……

lines.en: : I’ve been sucked into so many weird realities and met so many weird creatures at this point that these “pocket-hells” are basically just a way of life for me now.
lines.zh: : 到现在为止，我被吸进过太多稀奇古怪的现实、见过太多稀奇古怪的生物，以至于这些“袖珍地狱”对我而言基本上已经成了一种日常。

lines.en: : No, you’re getting it wrong again. This one is a pocket hell. Those other places you’re getting sucked into are something else.
lines.zh: : 不，你又理解错了。这个才叫袖珍地狱。你被吸进去的那些别的地方，是另外一回事。

lines.en: : Pocket-heaven?
lines.zh: : 袖珍天堂？

lines.en: : No, that-
: Pocket-purgatory?
lines.zh: : 袖珍炼狱？

lines.en: : Hah...
: Oh! Pockettory! Just combine the words. It’s easier that way.
lines.zh: : 哦！袖珍狱！直接把两个词合起来。这样省事。

lines.en: scene ayanetss27
: You still don’t understand how dire the situation you’re in is, do you?
lines.zh: : 你还是不明白自己的处境有多危急，是吗？

lines.en: : Your world is unstable and speeding toward collapse. Things like this shouldn’t happen, yet they are happening rapidly to both you and your peers on a regular basis now.
lines.zh: : 你的世界不稳定，而且正冲着崩塌一路狂奔。这种事本不该发生，可现在它们正快速、规律地发生在你和你同伴身上。

lines.en: : What good is a world at all if you can just leave it whenever you want?
lines.zh: : 如果一个世界你随时想走就走，那它还有什么意义？

lines.en: : I think the best world is one you can leave whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 我觉得最好的世界，就是那种你随时想走就能走的世界。

lines.en: scene ayanetss28
scene black
scene ayanetss29
: Imagine a place that’s perfect for you. The kind you made yourself instead of one that just fell into your lap out of convenience or circumstance or something like that.
lines.zh: : 想象一个对你来说完美的地方。那种你自己亲手造出来的，而不是因为方便或境遇什么的正好砸到你怀里的。

lines.en: : Even then, in that perfect world you worked so hard for, you’d get bored sometimes. Wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 可即便在那样一个你拼命换来的完美世界里，你有时候也会腻吧？难道不会吗？

lines.en: : The way you see it, the world is just a cage we’re trapped in. But if we’re not allowed to leave, then what? We just sit there and suffer? For how long? Why?
lines.zh: : 在你看来，世界不过是我们被困其中的笼子。可如果不准我们离开，那又怎样？我们就坐在那儿受苦？受多久？为了什么？

lines.en: : It’s in our nature to explore. To go see and feel things we can’t from the comfort of our homes.
lines.zh: : 探索本就是我们的天性。去看见、去感受那些在自己家里舒舒服服时感受不到的东西。

lines.en: : And, with that in mind, don’t you think it’d be amazing if the place we live in was just as expansive as our imaginations?
lines.zh: : 而既然如此，你不觉得吗——如果我们生活的地方，能跟我们的想象一样辽阔，那该多棒？

lines.en: : That optimism will be your undoing.
lines.zh: : 这份乐观会毁了你。

lines.en: scene ayanetss30
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: scene black
scene ayanetss31
: We’re in cages for a reason. It’d be dangerous for us to go out and “explore” like you say because of a little thing called malice.
lines.zh: : 我们被关在笼子里是有原因的。像你说的那样出去“探索”会很危险，因为有一样叫恶意的小东西。

lines.en: : Add that into the mixture and no world can be perfect since someone’s idea of fun will inevitably be finding that and destroying it.
lines.zh: : 把它掺进这个混合物里，就不可能有任何世界是完美的——因为总有人会把找到它、摧毁它当成乐趣。

lines.en: : Besides, if you take the world you live in for granted, you’ll miss out on the fact that its beauty stems from its impermanence. On how spontaneous and sudden everything within it is.
lines.zh: : 再说，如果你把生活的世界当成理所当然，你就会忽略一点：它的美，正源自它的无常。源自其中一切都那么自发、那么突然。

lines.en: : Think of it like seeing a rainbow. It’s far more exciting to catch a glimpse of one over the horizon than it is to draw one yourself, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 可以把它想成看彩虹。比起自己画一道，偶然在地平线上瞥见一道，要让人兴奋得多，不是吗？

lines.en: : You don’t seem like the type of girl who’d like rainbows, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，你看起来不像那种会喜欢彩虹的女孩。

lines.en: scene ayanetss32
: The point is...if you waste away your days wishing they’d be months or years instead, you’ll have less time to appreciate them.
lines.zh: : 重点是……如果你整天盼着日子变成几个月、几年，你用来珍惜它们的时间就少了。

lines.en: : Then they’ll all be gone. Just like that. And the next thing you know, you’ll be staring down the past through a looking glass, wishing you’d have done things a little differently.
lines.zh: : 然后它们就全没了。就那么没了。等你回过神来，你已经在透过一面回望镜盯着过去了，只盼着当初能换个做法。

lines.en: : There’s no use talking about any of it to you, though. I already know how this ends.
lines.zh: : 不过跟你说这些也没用。我已经知道这事会怎么收尾了。

lines.en: : How...what ends?
lines.zh: : 怎么……什么收尾？

lines.en: scene ayanetss33
: There’s a door over there that you can take back to your world. Just make sure to close it behind you.
lines.zh: : 那边有扇门，你可以从那儿回到你的世界。记得顺手把门关上。

lines.en: : Do you know how my story ends?
lines.zh: : 你知道我的故事是怎么结束的吗？

lines.en: : Would you want to know if I did?
lines.zh: : 如果我知道，你想听吗？

lines.en: scene ayanetss34
: No.
lines.zh: : 不想。

lines.en: : Didn’t think so.
lines.zh: : 我想也是。

lines.en: scene black
: Thank you, mysterious smoker girl. I’m sorry for interrupting your break and telling you to change your ways of life.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，神秘的抽烟女孩。很抱歉打扰了你休息，还对你说教要你改改生活方式。

lines.en: : The best way to apologize is to just leave me alone.
lines.zh: : 最好的道歉方式，就是别再来烦我。

lines.en: : Can you tell me your name at least?
lines.zh: : 至少能告诉我你的名字吧？
: 我是……

lines.en: : No.
: It’s probably better if I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我大概还是不说为好。

lines.en: scene ayanetss35
: Even when you aren’t here, you still find ways to annoy me.
lines.zh: : 就算你不在这儿，你也总有办法惹到我。

lines.en: : Your mom is doing just fine, Hima-chan.
lines.zh: : 你妈妈过得很好，Hima-chan。

lines.en: scene black
: All of your worrying isn’t going to help.
lines.zh: : 你再怎么担心也帮不上忙。
